text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Looks like a formidable rival has appeared for Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Since we're here,
let's brag to Dia-chan about it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'll send photos to everyone back home...
My classmates might like them too!
I'll put them up in the classroom for a while♪
